t.zh: 到这里，元件上的句子都由你来选：假设框假设什么，补充补上哪一句。很多时候，目标已经说明了该填什么。
t.en: So far you have chosen the sentences on parts yourself: what a box assumes, which side Add alternative adds. Often the goal already says what goes there.

t.zh: 规则可以写成带空位的形式：拼接是 ⟦?A; ?B⟧ ⟹ ?A ∧ ?B，方括号里是前提，⟹ 后面是结论。?A、?B 是<wiki-ref to="metavariable"></wiki-ref>。这套写法取自<wiki-ref to="isabelle"></wiki-ref>；<wiki-ref to="lean"></wiki-ref>也有元变量。
t.en: A rule can be written with blanks: Join is ⟦?A; ?B⟧ ⟹ ?A ∧ ?B, the premises in brackets, the conclusion after ⟹. ?A and ?B are <wiki-ref to="metavariable"></wiki-ref>s. The notation is <wiki-ref to="isabelle"></wiki-ref>’s; <wiki-ref to="lean"></wiki-ref> has metavariables too.

t.zh: 要把规则用到目标上，先得让它的结论和目标对上：解 ?A ∧ ?B ≐ 下雨 ∧ 刮风，求出 ?A 和 ?B。这叫<wiki-ref to="unification"></wiki-ref>。新元件「分解」：把两边结构相同的等式拆成对应部分之间的几个等式。
t.en: To use a rule on a goal, its conclusion must first fit the goal: solve ?A ∧ ?B ≐ it rains ∧ it is windy for ?A and ?B. This is <wiki-ref to="unification"></wiki-ref>. A new part, “Decompose”, splits an equation whose sides share a shape into equations between corresponding parts.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：把规则的结论和目标对上，拆到每个等式左边都只剩一个 ?-字母。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that fits a rule’s conclusion to a goal, splitting until each equation has a single ?-letter on its left.

hint.zh: 一个「分解」只拆一层。第三组测试有两层。
hint.en: One Decompose splits one level. The third test has two.
